technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Security framework to implement both File-based (in-memory/properties-based) and LDAP authentication mechanisms.
Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) supporting 'Admin' and 'Viewer' roles for endpoint access authorization.
Utilize Spring Security Kerberos and Hadoop client libraries for Kerberized authentication in the HDFS sink component.

Conduct a pure research/design spike for mass-database ingestion (U5) focusing on non-JDBC alternatives (e.g., CDC/Debezium, native database bulk utility integrations), delivering architectural specifications without production code implementation.
Build the HBase sink component using Spring Integration / Apache HBase client APIs supporting configurable table, column family, and record mapping.
Implement the File Roll sink module utilizing Spring Integration file writing adapters with configurable size-based and time-based file rotation policies.
Implement the JMX source module using Spring Integration JMX inbound notification channel adapters to publish JMX notifications into event flows.
assumptions: Development will target Java 17 and Spring Boot 3 / Spring Framework 6 standards.
Effort for each activity includes software design, coding, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation.
External test environments (Hadoop with Kerberos, LDAP directory, HBase cluster) will be mocked or run locally via Testcontainers during development.
User story U5 (Mass-ingest spike) requires only research, collaboration, and design documentation, with no component code delivery within this scope.

activities.activity_description: Setup module project structures, configure Spring Boot dependencies for Spring Security, Hadoop, HBase, JMX, and configure build pipelines.

activities.activity_name: File-based Security & Role-Based Access Control Implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement file-based security configuration (U1) and role-based authorization (U3) with Admin and Viewer access controls on target endpoints.
Configure Spring Security LDAP authentication provider (U2), mapping LDAP group attributes to application Admin and Viewer roles.
Develop HDFS sink module (U4) supporting Kerberos principal and keytab authentication for secure write operations into Hadoop Distributed File System.
Investigate non-JDBC data mass-ingestion alternatives (U5), collaborate on architectural design, and produce technical design specification document.
Develop HBase sink module (U6) to handle incoming data streams and execute random real-time writes into HBase tables.
Develop File Roll sink module (U7) enabling event persistence onto local file systems with configurable rolling/rotation policies.
Implement JMX source module (U8) leveraging Spring Integration JMX notification adapters to capture and publish JMX events.
Perform overall integration testing across security configurations, sinks, and sources, resolving integration issues and finalizing technical documentation.
